source: Kandal Provincial Department of Agriculture (មន្ទីរកសិកម្មខេត្តកណ្តាល), "ដំណំពោត" (Corn Crop / Zea mays production manual), 2015
text:
In Cambodia, corn can be planted in two seasons per year:

1) Early wet-season planting and late wet-season / recession-water planting (រដូវដើមឆ្នាំ និង រដូវចុងឆ្នាំ ឬ រដូវទឹកសម្រក)
2) Cambodia's national corn planting season

Early-season planting (រដូវដើមឆ្នាំ) begins from the Khmer months corresponding to April-August.

Recession/late-season planting (រដូវសម្រក) begins from the Khmer months corresponding to November-December.
